summary: Flat dip on a quiet residential street, homes 13-25 m off.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 13-25 m away on both sides; no bush or open space.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the kerb; room to park at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, 138 m long, light traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the kerb, but no overnight camping convention.

sun_shade: Street trees shade the north side; verge open to the sun, mostly midday.

best_section.where: Low point of Rennie Street, by the grassy verge between houses
